div.head: Grið 30
div.ab: Ealle we habbað ænne heofonlicne fæder ⁊ ane gastlice modor, seo is ‘ecclesia’ genamod, þæt is Godes cyrice; ⁊ þy we syn gebroðra.
Ealle we habbað ænne heofonlicne fæder and ane gastlice modor. Seo is Ecclesia genamod, þæt is Godes cyrice, and þy we syn gebroðra.
Alle haben wir Einen himmlischen Vater und eine geistliche Mutter, welche ecclesia genannt ist, das heisst Gottes Kirche; und darum sind wir Brüder.
We all have one heavenly Father and one spiritual mother, who is called ecclesia, that is, God's church; and therefore we are brothers.
We all have one heavenly father and one spiritual mother, who is named Ecclesia, that is, God’s Church; and therefore we are brothers.
